description: Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds) with lowest verified dealer prices and multi-dealer offer counts.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1 to 25, default 10).

matchedOnly.description: If true, return only products with multiple compared dealers.

search.description: Optional search keyword (e.g., 'American Eagle', 'Maple Leaf', '10 oz silver bar', 'Krugerrand').

name: search_bullion_catalog
title: Search Bullion Catalog
